hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty" | { read -r f; case "$f" in */core/designsystem/*) ;; *.kt) grep -q "Color(0x" "$f" && printf "{\"systemMessage\":\"Raw hex color in %s — colors are authored as oklch() in :core:designsystem (DESIGN.md).\"}" "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
